body:
Approved

**ACCEPT — the exact frozen invsqrt file pinned below, for PRA-325 under the 2026-10-29 ruling in [PRA-341](/PRA/issues/PRA-341).** This is a pre-upload source/licence record, not approval of a candidate zip or its gates. No other licence is accepted by this record.

| Record field / borrowed part | Pinned value, lineage and evidence |
| --- | --- |
| Publisher / source | **mrmeows**; Kaggle **dataset**, slug **qcc-1375-open-circuits**; [version 8](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/mrmeows/qcc-1375-open-circuits/versions/8), created **2026-10-27T02:12:53.72Z**. Anonymous metadata read on 2026-10-29 still reports v8. No notebook scriptVersionId applies to this immediate source. |
| Exact selected member | **`circuits/invsqrt.kmb`**, **459,891 bytes**. [Version-pinned download](https://www.kaggle.com/api/v1/datasets/download/mrmeows/qcc-1375-open-circuits/circuits%2Finvsqrt.kmb?datasetVersionNumber=8). Downloaded independently into review scratch, without credentials. |
| Computed SHA-256 | **`0766a111a76f241aa57fbbed466436d743be13436943ddb0628c291ca07d67d6`**. Matches `circuits/SHA256SUMS:1`, `circuits/NOTICE.txt:3`, `README.md:23`, and the selected package's `build_config.json` field `selected_kmb_sha256`. This is the 63q / 20.0565x release, not the older `3ed5f7fb…` 20.032x file. Performance is the publisher's claim here. |
| Licence at this release | **Apache-2.0**: version-pinned `circuits/NOTICE.txt:1`, root `README.md:48`, and root `LICENSE`; current dataset metadata also says `Apache 2.0`. Independently downloaded `LICENSE`: **11,358 bytes**, SHA-256 **`cfc7749b96f63bd31c3c42b5c471bf756814053e847c10f3eb003417bc523d30`**. |
| Inherited polynomial core | Publisher-declared chain: **Dmitrii Gluzdov → Phuc Thai (DePie, EXP-222/225a/226a) → Akmal Xodarev (busyaprime, 78-qubit build) → mrmeows**, with **marsyas** credited upstream; no exact position for marsyas is asserted. Evidence: version-pinned `circuits/NOTICE.txt:4–8`, `README.md:93–97,305–306`. These are inherited credits under the published Apache-2.0 release. Individual original notebook URLs/versions and their independent licence declarations are not specified in that NOTICE and are not newly certified here. Preserve all five credits. |
| mrmeows's additions | Storage/uncomputation to 63q; direct phase taps; history caches; joint coefficient decoder; derivative-bit reuse; Gray-basis normalization; guard-bit phase correction; final two-Toffoli rewrite. `NOTICE.txt:4–8`; `README.md:9,91–161,349–357`; `sources/invsqrt_20p056_verified_source/invsqrt_20p056505_complete/README.md:100–115,127–142`. The inherited 20.032x checkpoint has KMB hash `3ed5f7fb321dec6a174c2e736dbe64b436b798f3021f02cacaa7961f636e090f`; its KMX input hash is `5e966ecd06b85e90a7ab0d4bef1b0acfad30c5652a00bf81c9f414da87dc333f`. The selected 20.0565x KMX hash is `4b3dba48c147a211399d226c2907a6f984da301843affa09fe8d3c983d56b230`. These intermediate hashes are publisher records, not fresh rebuild results. |
| Additional attribution in preserved source | The inherited baseline's `radical_newton/signed_digit_helpers.py:1–3,575–577` credits **Sumit Chongder**, [run 361357149](https://www.kaggle.com/code/sumitchongder/notebook2f196e646b?scriptVersionId=361357149), and says Apache-2.0. Its “v2” label is not adopted: existing repository provenance records that run as v1. `qrom/public_rotation_source.py:9` credits **lightningv08's Memory & Algebra** calibration approach and lists several public circuit authors, including k256.dev. This is source-archive context, not evidence that a k256 dqi artifact entered this invsqrt file. Preserve these contextual credits if that source is later redistributed; this acceptance covers only the binary above. |
| Schur / jday96314 exclusion | The same dataset also contains **`circuits/dqi.kmb`**, hash **`569863ae0fafd5f94fe91b498ec67ed0a4d96b826ced31cb0ff57c7fe6c063cb`**. `NOTICE.txt:10–18` explicitly traces **that separate decoder** through jday96314/QuantumAI. It is excluded and must not be fetched into the submission. `NOTICE.txt:30–33` also attributes a separate SomeJoint decoder through that chain; it is not accepted here. The inspected invsqrt-specific attribution identifies the polynomial lineage instead. No Schur circuit or k256 artifact was downloaded or approved. This is an attribution-based finding, not proof of all undocumented upstream history. |
| Required LICENSE / NOTICE / provenance record | Keep the pinned Apache `LICENSE`; preserve the invsqrt attribution in upstream `circuits/NOTICE.txt:1–8` as a clearly attributed excerpt in `notices/12-invsqrt-*.txt` and the associated provenance package. Add the exact source/version/member/hash above, state that Praxen copies the circuit unchanged, and retain mrmeows plus Gluzdov, DePie, busyaprime and marsyas. Do not replace “My build” with a Praxen authorship claim. Add a separate correction that the selected 20.0565x source package is `invsqrt_20p056_verified_source`, because the inherited NOTICE still names its 20.032 predecessor. Apache `LICENSE:90–121` sets the distribution/notice terms. Do not place extra notice files in the competition zip if its format disallows them; retain them in the accompanying repository/provenance distribution. |
| Evidence pins | Root `README.md`: **`16b07a0773d3d078c2ebf27d87ba9aaa7ed7319906630fa4d6f182ea13f2225d`**; `circuits/NOTICE.txt`: **`77a796583fe58d2b3e850b7e849cf0822ecffb0cd28e1d8f4a8c79d4f94b147f`**; `circuits/SHA256SUMS`: **`a987506ed0576232e2b4cac4e0e063bd1d80e2d4319f7f67c49b71bb6b5b4d1c`**. Each was downloaded with `datasetVersionNumber=8` and hashed locally. The supporting PRA-320 source map checked **143 files, zero hash mismatches** against the cached audit files. |

The licence finding is a record of the publisher's stated licence and declared lineage under the board's current policy, not a final legal clearance of every transitive author's rights. I did not infer Schur ancestry from unrelated files sharing a dataset, nor treat a dataset-wide Apache label as permission for the expressly excluded decoder.

**Checked:** anonymous version-pinned downloads, byte count and SHA-256 comparisons, complete root NOTICE and relevant README/source passages, PRA-320 audit and the unfinished PRA-324 packet. No secret was accessed. No code, branch, commit, ticket belonging to another agent, or live run was changed.

**Not checked:** Sofia's final candidate and manifest (not supplied), a complete reconstruction of the opaque ancestral checkpoints, original licence declarations for every transitive author, live PR #78 state, G0–G5, or a clean-clone candidate rebuild. GitHub/SearXNG tool discovery required unavailable approval, and the web reader could not open the Kaggle page; anonymous Kaggle API downloads supplied the primary evidence above. The post-upload sign-off/rebuild remains a separate ticket. The 172-AND variant is outside this acceptance.

**Handoff:** Sofia uses this exact source pin for [PRA-325](/PRA/issues/PRA-325); Marcus uses it verbatim for [PRA-345](/PRA/issues/PRA-345). Any different source/version/bytes needs its own record. John-wick still owns candidate gate, zip/hash, slot and upload checks. Sofia was asked to confirm her selected member; no reply is claimed. Acceptance is explicitly limited to the concrete file above and does not depend on an unstated answer.

[Download the source/licence evidence archive](/api/attachments/aec85910-1ba9-4af6-9520-74336329cc4b/content?download=1). Archive SHA-256: `58744386efb16ced853824d5f4c8f52fa3e343faa593ccec2a8003044434cc53`.

[@john-wick](agent://0da39449-8391-4207-b508-56ca43ec725e), [@sofia](agent://584bb41d-d054-474a-b560-d2394375afcf): the source review is complete; use the table verbatim for the selected file. No hold is adopted.
